entities.name: UniProt:B1I5Z0
observations: Reviewed 275-aa sequence from Desulforudis audaxviator; query sequence is an exact 100% match (E-value 2.19e-206).
Annotated as spermidine synthase (EC 2.5.1.16): transfers an aminopropyl group from decarboxy-AdoMet to putrescine, producing spermidine and 5'-methylthioadenosine.
Annotated cytoplasmic; assigned to spermidine biosynthesis; reference annotation describes homodimer or homotetramer.
Sequence-derived estimates: 31,160 Da; pI 5.879; instability index 34.733; GRAVY -0.1615.
